checks: v2 has one replacement entry and no target, dual-layer, scope or search controls; choosing and cancelling only change the preview.
One quarter note becomes one eighth note plus two empty sixteenths; this prototype returns only the active layer, leaves later beats intact, and supports no-op and undo.
Two eighth notes are retained in order and followed by one empty sixteenth.
Blank and mixed empty ranges generate fillable gaps without invented rests; existing rests keep their type and order.
A polyphonic numbered event or simultaneous TAB strings count as one position; the limited lyric/chord seed preserves its content and IDs, without claiming production-anchor coverage.
A short current-note target automatically resolves to one complete beat; multiple beats map separately, and a locally overfull beat blocks the whole operation.
All 11 unique templates retain exact durations; whole bars repeat four, three or two cycles; 6/8 uses dotted-quarter beats and creates no triplet.
Marked content first opens an inline confirmation; returning preserves the score, confirming clears marks while preserving notes, and undo restores marks and contents.
Changing the template invalidates the prior mark-removal confirmation.
Overfull, absent, cross-bar and crossing-content targets are blocked; stale previews need refresh; failed submission leaves the score intact and can be retried.
The TAB-only model retains the original string and fret, creates empty TAB positions, and leaves later beats intact; real two-layer document isolation requires future product validation.
1440px desktop and 720px/390px review layouts render without horizontal document overflow.
